techRefinements.title: Set up Cassandra cluster for message storage
techRefinements.description: Provision a 3-node Cassandra cluster on Kubernetes. Create the messages keyspace and table with the channel-partitioned schema. Configure replication factor 3 with LOCAL_QUORUM consistency for writes.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Use Cassandra 4.x. Partition key: channel_id. Clustering key: created_at DESC for efficient recent-message queries. Set default_time_to_live = 220752000 (7 years in seconds). Enable commitlog for durability.
acceptanceCriteria: Cassandra cluster running with 3 nodes in separate AZs
messages table created with correct schema and TTL
Write latency < 5ms at p95 for single-row inserts under load test
Replication factor 3, LOCAL_QUORUM reads and writes confirmed

techRefinements.title: Configure Redis Pub/Sub for message fan-out
techRefinements.description: Set up Redis Cluster (6 nodes, 3 masters, 3 replicas) for WebSocket fan-out and rate limiting. Each channel maps to a Redis Pub/Sub topic. Message Service instances subscribe on first active connection.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Use Redis 7.x. Channel topics: `ch:{channel_id}`. Rate limit keys: `ratelimit:msg:{user_id}` with sliding window (30 messages / 60s). Connection set: `channel:{channel_id}:subscribers`. TTL on rate limit keys: 120s.
acceptanceCriteria: Redis cluster deployed with AOF persistence enabled
Fan-out latency < 20ms for a message published to a channel with 500 subscribers
Rate limit correctly blocks after 30 messages per minute per user
Subscriber set correctly tracks active connections across pods

techRefinements.title: Implement WebSocket connection management in Message Service
techRefinements.description: Build the WebSocket connection handler in the Message Service. Handle subscribe/unsubscribe/send message types. On connect: register in Redis. On disconnect: deregister. On pod restart: connections are re-established by client with exponential backoff.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Use ws library (Node.js). Each connection holds state: userId, subscribed channelIds. On message receipt: validate auth token, enforce rate limit, write to Cassandra, publish to Redis. Handle backpressure: drop new connections if pod is at 80% of 2,000 connection limit.
acceptanceCriteria: Single Message Service pod handles 2,000 concurrent WebSocket connections under load
subscribe/send/unsubscribe message types handled correctly
Connection deregistered from Redis on disconnect (clean and unclean)
Client receives delivered message within 500ms under 5,000 concurrent connection load test

techRefinements.title: Build async moderation pipeline
techRefinements.description: Implement the two-stage moderation pipeline. Stage 1: synchronous rule-based check (blocklist + velocity detection) before write. Stage 2: async LLM classifier call after write; update moderation_status in Cassandra and deliver or hold accordingly.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Stage 1 runs synchronously in the message handler, must complete in < 5ms. Stage 2 is a background job using a Node.js worker thread pool. LLM classifier: use Claude Haiku for cost efficiency (~$0.0003 per classification). Hold queue: Redis sorted set `moderation:pending` with score = created_at.
acceptanceCriteria: Stage 1 rule-based check adds < 5ms to message send latency
Blocked keyword message is not delivered to channel members
Velocity threshold (>10 same-ticker mentions / 5 min) correctly triggers hold
LLM classifier achieves > 92% precision on pump-and-dump test corpus
Human review queue is accessible to compliance team via internal Slack workflow

techRefinements.title: Implement Kafka + S3 archive pipeline
techRefinements.description: Set up a Kafka topic `messages.archive`. Debezium connector captures Cassandra inserts and publishes to the topic. A Kafka consumer writes to S3 as Parquet files, partitioned by channel_id/year/month. Athena table configured for compliance queries.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Use Kafka 3.x. Debezium Cassandra connector for CDC. Consumer: Apache Kafka Streams or Flink (TBD with data engineering). S3 bucket: xCube-messages-archive with 7-year lifecycle policy. Athena: CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE over S3 with Parquet serde.
acceptanceCriteria: All new messages written to S3 within 1 hour of creation
Athena query for messages by userId + date range returns results in < 30s
Archive record includes all required fields including moderation_status
S3 bucket has 7-year object lock enabled

techRefinements.title: Add Prometheus metrics and alerting for message pipeline
techRefinements.description: Instrument the Message Service with Prometheus metrics. Configure Grafana dashboard. Set up PagerDuty alerts for SLA breach.
techRefinements.technicalNotes: Key metrics: message_send_duration_ms (histogram), ws_connections_active (gauge), moderation_queue_depth (gauge), message_delivery_latency_ms (histogram), cassandra_write_duration_ms (histogram). Alert thresholds: p95 delivery > 1s for 5 min, moderation queue depth > 500 for 10 min.
acceptanceCriteria: Grafana dashboard live with all key metrics
PagerDuty alert fires when p95 delivery latency exceeds 1,000ms for 5 minutes
Alert fires when moderation queue depth exceeds 500 messages
